## Euryale (CR 22)

**XP** 615,000  
LE Large outsider (evil, extraplanar, lawful)  
**Init** +7; **Senses** darkvision 120 ft.; Perception +30  


**Defense**


**AC** 42, touch 13, flat-footed 38 (+1 dodge, +3 Dex, +29 natural, –1 size)  
**hp** 360 (20d10+160); fast healing 5  
**Fort** +14; **Ref** +17; **Will** +19  
**DR** 15/epic and good; **Immune** paralysis, polymorph, sleep, stunning; **SR** 33  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft., fly 50 ft. (poor)  
**Melee** 2 claws +32 (2d6+12 plus grab), bite +32 (1d10+12), snake bite +30 (1d8+6 plus poison)  
**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  
**Special Attacks** petrifying gaze, poison, rend (2 claws, 2d6+18)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 35, **Dex** 17, **Con** 26, **Int** 24, **Wis** 24, **Cha** 28  
**Base Atk** +20; **CMB** +33 (+37 grapple); **CMD** 47 (can’t be tripped)  
**Feats** Cleave, Great Cleave, Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Multiattack, Vital Strike, Weapon Focus (bite) Weapon Focus (claw), Weapon Focus (snake bite), [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Dodgility.*  
**Skills** Acrobatics +26, Bluff +32, Craft (alchemy) +30, Diplomacy +32, Fly +20, Intimidate +32, Knowledge (arcana) +30, Knowledge (dungeoneering) +27, Knowledge (planes) +30, Perception +30, Sense Motive +30, Stealth +22, Survival +27  
**SQ** immortal  
**Languages** Abyssal, Aklo, Common, Draconic, Infernal, Terran, Undercommon  


**Special Abilities**


**Immortal (Ex)** Sthenno is immortal and cannot die from natural causes. She is not subject to death from massive damage and is immune to death effects and disintegration. She does not age, and does not need to sleep, eat, or breathe.  

**Petrifying Gaze (Su)** *Turn to stone* permanently, 30 feet, Fortitude save (DC 29) negates. The save DC is Charisma-based.  

**Poison (Ex)** Bite—injury; *save* Fort DC 28; *frequency* 1/round for 6 rounds; *effect* 1d6 Strength; *cure* 1 save.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** Outer Planes  
**Organization** solitary, pair (Sthenno and Euryale), or troupe (true gorgon plus 2–8 medusa and 1–4 greater medusa)  
**Treasure** triple standard
